description: Source code for NVIDIA's X11 extension library (NVCtrl), handling extension queries, event processing, and attribute management for NVIDIA graphics hardware via X11 protocol.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryExtension
methods.description: Checks if the NV-CONTROL extension is available on the display and retrieves event and error base codes.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryVersion
methods.description: Queries the version of the NV-CONTROL extension supported by the server.

methods.name: XNVCTRLIsNvScreen
methods.description: Checks if a given screen is an NVIDIA NV screen.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryTargetCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of available targets of a specified type.

methods.name: XNVCTRLSetTargetAttribute
methods.description: Sets an attribute for a specific target.

methods.name: XNVCTRLSetAttribute
methods.description: Sets an attribute for a specified X screen.

methods.name: XNVCTRLSetTargetAttributeAndGetStatus
methods.description: Sets an attribute for a target and retrieves the success status.

methods.name: XNVCTRLSetAttributeAndGetStatus
methods.description: Sets an attribute for a screen and retrieves the success status.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryTargetAttribute
methods.description: Queries the value of an attribute for a specific target.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryAttribute
methods.description: Queries the value of an attribute for a screen.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryTargetAttribute64
methods.description: Queries a 64-bit attribute value for a target.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryTargetStringAttribute
methods.description: Queries a string attribute for a target.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryStringAttribute
methods.description: Queries a string attribute for a screen.

methods.name: XNVCTRLSetTargetStringAttribute
methods.description: Sets a string attribute for a target.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryValidTargetAttributeValues
methods.description: Queries valid values for a target attribute, handling 32 and 64-bit variants.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryValidAttributeValues
methods.description: Queries valid values for a screen attribute.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryValidTargetStringAttributeValues
methods.description: Queries valid string values for a target attribute.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryStringAttributePermissions
methods.description: Queries permissions for string attributes.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryAttributePermissions
methods.description: Queries permissions for attributes.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryStringOperationAttributePermissions
methods.description: Queries permissions for string operation attributes.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryBinaryDataAttributePermissions
methods.description: Queries permissions for binary data attributes.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryTargetBinaryData
methods.description: Retrieves binary data for a target attribute.

methods.name: XNVCTRLStringOperation
methods.description: Performs a string operation on a target attribute.

methods.name: XNVCtrlSelectTargetNotify
methods.description: Subscribes or unsubscribes to target notifications.

methods.name: XNVCtrlSelectNotify
methods.description: Subscribes or unsubscribes to screen notifications.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryTargetBinaryData
methods.description: Wrapper to query binary data for a screen target.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryTargetStringAttribute
methods.description: Wrapper to query string attribute for a screen target.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryStringAttribute
methods.description: Wrapper to query string attribute for a screen.

methods.name: XNVCTRLSetStringAttribute
methods.description: Wrapper to set string attribute for a screen.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryValidTargetAttributeValues64
methods.description: Queries valid 64-bit values for a target attribute.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryValidTargetAttributeValues32
methods.description: Queries valid 32-bit values for a target attribute.

methods.name: XNVCTRLQueryGvoColorConversion
methods.description: Queries GVO color conversion parameters for a screen.

methods.name: XNVCTRLSetGvoColorConversion
methods.description: Sets GVO color conversion parameters for a screen.
